native_qualification.compiler_execution: Pinned original PS1 GCC 2.7.2 and 2.8.1 C/C++ host packages; no WSL, wibo or QEMU in native qualification.
native_qualification.additional_checks_status: All passed at the tested source commit.

local_qualification.compiler_execution: Private i386 compatibility harness for original Linux PS1 compilers; these local counts do not establish native Windows/Linux compiler qualification.

coverage: Original compiler-version code, relocation, constant-data and genuine C++ parity
C/C++ boot program source recovery, strict matching and clean standalone exports
Complete ISO 2048, raw 2352 Mode 1/Mode 2 Form 1 and 2448-byte-frame matching reconstruction
Raw overlays with prefixes, PS-X EXE overlay headers, shared overlay addresses and partial replacement of resident RAM
Module-specific targets, claims and independent C++ recovery in two mutually exclusive overlays
Nested boot paths and same-basename programs in different directories
Different discs with identical boot code and different resources retain separate projects and independently rebuild
Clean exports in paths with spaces; original disc hashes, file extents, executable trailers, opaque sector metadata, audio and subcode preserved
Wrong source, targets, addresses and corrupted original discs rejected; stale standalone disc outputs removed
Cyclic, truncated, malformed, duplicate, unsupported and oversized filesystem extents fail or report program-only coverage

multi_disc.scope: Import and reconstruct each disc as a separate project in the same workspace.
multi_disc.shared_source: Manual reuse only where each project independently verifies it.

retail_validation.inputs: Original fixtures only; no PS1 retail images supplied.

not_qualified: Runtime correctness of inferred raw-overlay addresses without loader review
Per-overlay GP/BSS recovery; compiler/GP assumptions remain project-wide
Runtime relocation tables, custom/compressed/archive overlay adapters and complete code discovery
Interleaved, multi-extent, multi-volume and extended-attribute ISO rebuilding
CUE/M3U authoring, absent-track reconstruction and CHD recompression
Additional PSY-Q compiler or Sony ASPSX versions
Changed-size file/sector authoring or modified-payload EDC/ECC regeneration
